description.value:
Your eidolon is a digital interface given form. It may resemble a virtual pet, a video game character, a digital assistant, or any other form that exists within your holopad. Given form, your eidolon most resembles hardlight constructs and can similarly adept at causing interference with other tech beings.

Tradition Arcane

Traits construct, eidolon, tech

Home Plane the Universe

Size Medium or Small

Suggested Attacks sword (slashing), jaws (piercing), advert (bludgeoning)

Eidolon Attributes Con +1, Int +2, Wis -1, Cha +1

Skills Arcana, Computers

Senses darkvision

Language one common language

Speed 25 feet

Initial (1st) @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.su-eidolons.Item.3VQy9ZLZaSgoNQMP]{Digital Form}

Your eidolon's digital form is materialized, but retains a connection to digital wavelengths. Your eidolon's unarmed attacks gain the versatile force trait. Additionally, when it critically succeeds a Strike against a creature or hazard with the tech trait or a creature that wields or wears a tech item, the target or one required tech item of your choice becomes Glitching 1.

Symbiosis (7th) @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.su-eidolons.Item.8hqhKp3g6t4rRMLF]{Digitized Countermeasures}

Your eidolon creates visible digitized signals on all creatures nearby. Your eidolon gains a digitized aura in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. Visible creatures in the aura can't be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and invisible creatures are concealed rather than @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}. Your eidolon can disable these countermeasures by spending a single action, which has the concentrate trait and they can take this action again to reinstate their aura.

Use the toggle on the eidolon's sheet to switch the aura on or off.

Transcendence (17th) @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.su-eidolons.Item.Fr2yEBPa9aHOyIcQ]{Technomatic Mastery}

Your eidolon can cast read memory, holographic stand-in, and overload systems once per day each as 9th-rank arcane innate spells.

Starfinder 2e content. Computers is a Starfinder skill; in a Pathfinder-only game it is tracked as a Computers Lore skill.

Eidolon actor: give your eidolon the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.su-eidolons.Item.hkRmy0VjTCAD8F2x]{Program Eidolon} ancestry from the Summons Unleashed Eidolons compendium.
